description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableWithSender' that implements the 'WithSender' interface, representing a message with an associated sender, within an Akka-based control flow context.

classes.name: ImmutableWithSender
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating a message of type T (which extends WithDittoHeaders) and an ActorRef sender, providing getter methods, a method to create a new instance with a different message, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

methods.name: ImmutableWithSender
methods.description: Constructor initializing message and sender fields.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message of type T.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableWithSender instance with a new message but the same sender.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on message and sender fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on message and sender.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name, message, and sender.
